question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

Slack
solution:
The correct answer is '**Inactive**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate synonym of the given word '**Slack**' is '**Inactive**'.
 
• **Slack**: loose; not tightly stretched. (शिथिल, ढीला; जो कसा हुआ न हो)
 
 
• *Example: Leave the rope **slack**.*
 
 
 
• **Inactive**: doing nothing; not active. (कुछ न करने वाला; निष्क्रिय)
 
 
• *Example: The virus remains **inactive** in the body.*

 
 
 

**Correct Answer:__** *Inactive.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

__
 
• Let's look at the meaning of other words:
 
 
• **Hyperactive**: (used especially about children and their behaviour) not able to sit still and keep quiet for more than a short period of time and difficult to control; too active or easily excited. [(विशेषकर बच्चों और उनके व्यवहार के संदर्भ में) बहुत देर तक शांत बैठने में असमर्थ तथा नियंत्रित करने में कठिन; अतिसक्रिय या सहज उत्तेजित होनेवाला; अतिक्रियाशील]
 
• **Provocation**: doing or saying something deliberately to try to make somebody angry or upset; something that is said or done to cause this. (किसी को क्रोधित या परेशान करने के लिए जान-बूझकर की गई बात, हरकत आदि)
 
• **Tight**: fixed firmly in position and difficult to move or remove. [किसी स्‍थान पर कसकर बँधा हुआ (जिसका हिलना या जिसे हिलाना कठिन हो)]
